Asked how to bless him, the Prophet taught asking Allah to bless Muhammad and his family as He blessed Abraham's family; whoever blesses him once, Allah blesses ten times.
The Prophet and his community were given what others were not: mission to all mankind, lawful spoils, the earth as mosque and purifier, terror in enemies' hearts, intercession, concise speech.
Allah chose Kinana from Ishmael's descendants, then Quraysh, Banu Hashim and the Prophet; a stone in Mecca greeted him before prophethood, and he will be first intercessor on Resurrection Day.
The Prophet likened himself among the earlier Apostles to the one missing brick in a fine house, the last of the Apostles who completes the building.
The Prophet named himself Muhammad, Ahmad, al-Mahi through whom unbelief is wiped out, al-Hashir at whose feet people are gathered, al-Aqib after whom no prophet comes, and Prophet of Mercy.
The Prophet said a day would come when a glimpse of him would be dearer to a person than family, property and everything else.
The Prophet says those of his Ummah he loves most will come after him, each longing to see him even at the cost of family and wealth.
